items.summary: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2: an authenticated attacker can exploit LDAP injection to gain unauthorized administrative access to other tenants. Fixed in 12.1.1.3.
TOTOLINK CA300-PoE 6.2c.884: a buffer overflow in the setIpQosRules handler, triggered remotely via the ipStart argument, with the exploit publicly disclosed.

Keycloak's client management component fails to clear a session attribute during client setup, letting an authenticated attacker with client-management permissions import a malicious JavaScript policy that executes on the server — arbitrary code execution.
IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2: hard-coded credentials could allow a remote attacker to gain full administrative control.

The Fiber Admin WordPress plugin before 4.0.1 writes an unvalidated request header into a regenerated PHP file, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code when its custom database error page is enabled.
